battery.tip: Fire hazard! Do NOT throw in normal bins. Take to nearest battery drop-off.

can.tip: Rinse clean before discarding in the metal bin.

cardboard_bowl.tip: If clean, recycle in paper bin. If heavily grease/food stained, discard in wet waste.

cardboard_box.tip: Flatten box completely to save bin space.

chemical_plastic_bottle.tip: Contains chemical residue. Do not mix with domestic recycling.

chemical_plastic_gallon.tip: Industrial/hazardous chemical container. Dispose at designated drop-off.

chemical_spray_can.tip: Pressurized aerosol hazard! Do not puncture or expose to heat.

light_bulb.tip: May contain mercury or delicate electronics. Handle with care.

paint_bucket.tip: Chemical paint residue. Needs special municipal hazardous disposal.

plastic_bag.tip: Clean and bundle together or take to dedicated plastic bag drop-off.

plastic_bottle.tip: Empty liquids and crush before discarding.

plastic_bottle_cap.tip: Small plastic item. Screw back onto empty bottle or place in plastic bin.

plastic_box.tip: Rinse clean and dry before recycling.

plastic_cultery.tip: Most single-use plastic cutlery cannot be recycled mechanically.

plastic_cup.tip: Empty contents and rinse liquid out.

plastic_cup_lid.tip: Separate lid from cup before binning.

reuseable_paper.tip: Reuse for rough work/notes if possible, otherwise recycle dry.

scrap_paper.tip: Keep dry and deposit in the paper recycling bin.

scrap_plastic.tip: Place in the dry plastic recycling bin.

snack_bag.tip: Multi-layer foil/plastic laminate is rarely recyclable curbside.

stick.tip: Natural wood / garden waste. Suitable for compost or organic bin.

straw.tip: Too small for standard sorting machinery. Dispose in general waste.
